title: Correct CurrReport.Skip guidance and retire false fixture expectations
summary: Updated reporting guidance to correct false assumptions about CurrReport.Skip behavior in AL triggers, removing incorrect fixture examples and refocusing on accurate documentation of trigger dispatch and dataset behavior.
key_points: Corrected the assumption that code after CurrReport.Skip() continues in the same OnAfterGetRecord trigger
Separated guidance for same-trigger exit from later trigger dispatch and dataset omission concerns
Removed false positive and clean sample pairs that claimed Skip behavior was unsafe within the same trigger
Retired outdated evaluation registration and fixture expectations for the incorrect Skip guidance
Preserved correct CurrReport.Break() versus AL break distinction with unchanged documentation
